title: v4.1.3 recover OpenClaw config and configure Ollama
backup: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null; $cfgDir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; if(Test-Path $cfgDir){$bak=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-config-before-049t'; if(Test-Path $bak){Remove-Item $bak -Recurse -Force}; Copy-Item $cfgDir $bak -Recurse -Force}; Write-Output 'V413_049T_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $cfgDir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; $target=Join-Path $cfgDir 'openclaw.json'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $cfgDir | Out-Null; $searchRoots=@($cfgDir,$root); $candidates=@(); foreach($sr in $searchRoots){if(-not(Test-Path $sr)){continue}; Get-ChildItem $sr -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'openclaw.*(json|bak|backup)$' -or $_.FullName -match 'openclaw-config-before-'} | ForEach-Object { try{$raw=Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if($raw.Length -lt 1000){return}; $obj=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop; $gw=$obj.PSObject.Properties['gateway']; if($null -eq $gw){return}; $candidates += [pscustomobject]@{path=$_.FullName;len=$raw.Length;time=$_.LastWriteTimeUtc;raw=$raw} }catch{} }}; if($candidates.Count -lt 1){throw 'NO_VALID_OPENCLAW_CONFIG_CANDIDATE'}; $best=$candidates|Sort-Object time,len -Descending|Select-Object -First 1; $tmp=$target+'.3en-new'; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmp,[string]$best.raw,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false))); Move-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Destination $target -Force; $check=Get-Content $target -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; if($null -eq $check.PSObject.Properties['gateway']){throw 'RESTORED_CONFIG_GATEWAY_MISSING'}; if((Get-Item $target).Length -lt 1000){throw 'RESTORED_CONFIG_TOO_SMALL'}; $ports=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]; [void]$ports.Add(11434); try{Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop|Where-Object {$_.LocalAddress -in @('127.0.0.1','0.0.0.0','::1','::')}|ForEach-Object {[void]$ports.Add([int]$_.LocalPort)}}catch{}; $eps=@(); foreach($p in $ports){if($p -lt 1024){continue}; try{$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:'+$p+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop; $names=@($r.models|ForEach-Object {$_.name}); if($names.Count -gt 0){$eps += [pscustomobject]@{baseUrl=('http://127.0.0.1:'+$p);models=$names}}}catch{}}; if($eps.Count -lt 1){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_WITH_MODELS'}; $preferred=@('qwen3:8b','qwen2.5-coder:14b','mistral-nemo','deepseek-r1:14b'); $chosen=$null; foreach($e in $eps){foreach($m in $preferred){if(@($e.models)-contains $m){$chosen=[pscustomobject]@{baseUrl=$e.baseUrl;model=$m};break}};if($chosen){break}}; if(-not $chosen){$e=$eps[0];$chosen=[pscustomobject]@{baseUrl=$e.baseUrl;model=[string]$e.models[0]}}; $chosen|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint.json') -Encoding UTF8; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OLLAMA_API_KEY','ollama-local','User'); $env:OLLAMA_API_KEY='ollama-local'; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.baseUrl $chosen.baseUrl 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OLLAMA_BASEURL_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.api 'ollama' 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OLLAMA_API_MODE_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.apiKey 'ollama-local' 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OLLAMA_APIKEY_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw models set ('ollama/'+$chosen.model) 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $root 'model-set-049t.txt') | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_MODEL_SET_FAILED'}; $chosen.model|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Encoding ASCII; Write-Output ('V413_049T_RESTORED_FROM='+$best.path); Write-Output ('V413_049T_ENDPOINT='+$chosen.baseUrl); Write-Output ('V413_049T_MODEL='+$chosen.model)
test: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json'; if(-not(Test-Path $cfg)){throw 'OPENCLAW_CONFIG_MISSING'}; $raw=Get-Content $cfg -Raw; if($raw.Length -lt 1000){throw 'OPENCLAW_CONFIG_TOO_SMALL'}; $obj=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json; if($null -eq $obj.PSObject.Properties['gateway']){throw 'OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_CONFIG_MISSING'}; $e=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $null=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($e.baseUrl+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 3 -ErrorAction Stop; $m=(Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Raw).Trim(); $list=& openclaw models list --provider ollama 2>&1|Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_OLLAMA_LIST_FAILED'}; if($list -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw 'SELECTED_MODEL_NOT_VISIBLE'}; Write-Output 'V413_049T_TEST=PASS'
